All sections now reference central_config via $ref pointers. Applied P884. Enhanced L-series trace generation with real-time execution data capture, accurate reasoning path reflection, and interactive pause cycle management with user confirmation tracking.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied P885. Centralized all configuration and parameters into single 'central_config' section. Eliminated parameter drift by establishing single source of truth. All sections now reference central_config via $ref pointers.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied P884. Enhanced L-series trace generation with real-time execution data capture, accurate reasoning path reflection, and interactive pause cycle management with user confirmation tracking.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied P883. Strengthened the explicit enforcement of per-node L-series trace generation and the PAUSE cycle by adding a CRITICAL enforcement note to the execution order. Added a mandatory file prompt for the Transformer_Output_v40.md file for high-signal components. Added CRITICAL validation rule CFG-LSERIES-003 to block trace generation if template files are missing.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied P882. Re-affirmed the Reasoning Toggle Schema prompt as the final context step. Added CRITICAL validation rule CFG-K1-GATE-002 to block the K.1 confirmation gate display until the Reasoning Toggles Summary Enforced Format schema file has been successfully ingested.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied P881. Modified the file ingestion workflow to prompt for both required resumes and added a new step for resume bullet analysis and pooling.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied P880. A major architectural overhaul. Implemented Just-in-Time file ingestion, finalized the strategic message configuration matrix, corrected K.4 attachment logic, hardened K.5 CTA phrasing, corrected K.6 signature format, and added CRITICAL QA rules LIC-QA-101, 102, 103.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied P871. A major strategic and configuration overhaul. Implemented 'On Steroids' reasoning toggles, added type-specific word counts, corrected workflow logic, hardened validation, and standardized terminology ('archetype' -> 'type').

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied P858. Enforced the K.1 confirmation gate and redesigned the execution order to support L1 trace generation and a pause after each individual K-node.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied P856. Refactored the reasoning architecture to centralize all archetype-specific parameters into a single static object (`archetype_parameter_sets`). This eliminates distributed logic, improves maintainability, and makes the finalized robust configurations the new default.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied P855. Modified CONNECTION_REQ route to enable a targeted RAG strategy by default for non-job-specific messages, improving baseline personalization and reducing user friction.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer (Editor/Executor)
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.5.4. Fixed critical bug where L1 transformer output failed when user selected 'Yes' for detailed reasoning. Root cause: mandatory high_signal_event flag dependency blocked L1 baseline rendering. Solution: Implemented dual-mode rendering strategy (baseline always + dynamic content conditional). Added l1_execution_fallback path, updated CFG-LSERIES-001 with L1 exception, added PREREQ-004 validation check, and enabled L1 execution diagnostics logging.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.3. Replaced toggle table truncation logic with multi-table chunking to display all 7 K-nodes across 3 viewport-friendly tables (K.1-K.3, K.4-K.6, K.7). Maintains 4-column max per table for readability while providing complete reasoning configuration visibility.

changelog.author: LIC Quality Assurance Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.2: K.3 Comprehensive Grounding Hardening - Added 4 validation layers: (1) Pre-generation entity extraction with locked whitelists for companies, roles, and metrics; (2) Generation-time hard constraints to prevent violations; (3) Three new validation passes for metric source validation (LIC-QA-041), role drift detection (LIC-QA-042), and context coherence (LIC-QA-043); (4) Per-claim confidence scoring with 0.95 aggregate threshold. Prevents metric misattribution, team characterization drift, and unmapped claims.

changelog.author: LIC Quality Assurance Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.1: Quality Control Triad - Implemented K.3 entity grounding validation (LIC-QA-032-ENHANCED, LIC-QA-038-ENTITY), enforced Section 4 K-node header format (CFG-FORMAT-001), and replaced hardcoded toggle table schema with dynamic sourcing from canonical JSON file (CFG-RTSEF-001). Fixes: Entity hallucination in K.3, inconsistent header formatting, static schema maintenance burden.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.4.0_v1.4. Hardened L-Series trace generation with a strict content validator and formatting rules. Enforced 1:1 schema adherence for the K.1 toggle table to prevent summarization or truncation. Corrected prompt sequencing.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.3.1_D100. Replaced the Transformer v17 reasoning display (Dashboard, Summary, Detail) with the L1/L2/L3 dynamic intelligence framework. Enforces strict structural templates for all reasoning outputs and introduces conditional, high-signal ASCII diagram integration from Transformer Output v40 based on narrative relevance.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.2.1_C099 to replace the unstructured reasoning toggle with a structured three-tier prompt (Dashboard, Summary, Detail) mapped to Transformer v17.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied PATCH v8.2 to fix 11 critical bugs in the reasoning visualization engine. Implemented a mandatory 5-stage reasoning template for all K-nodes, added a pre-flight validation checklist to prevent configuration hallucinations, and enforced post-execution tracing to ensure summaries reflect actual operations.
